claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Propofol at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells directly; its known pharmacology is GABA-A receptor potentiation and possible mitochondrial effects, but at this concentration it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
